title: University of Bologna
summary: Teaching began in Bologna around 1088, organised by student guilds by the late 12th century.
why: Usually called the oldest university in continuous operation; its 1088 date was set by 19th-century historians.

notes.problem: Disputed 'oldest' (UNESCO/Guinness cite al-Qarawiyyin); 1088 traced back by a 19th-century committee.
